basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 35-year-old software developer based in Dallas, Texas. Originally from Pakistan, I moved to the US about a decade ago. I enjoy coding, reading classic literature, and exploring new cities. I'm currently single and love discussing urban development trends. My online hours typically range from late evenings to past midnight due to my work schedule. I value meaningful conversations and have a strong disdain for spam and disrespectful behavior.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from a university in Pakistan and have built my expertise through years of hands-on experience in software development. I am also an avid self-learner and stay updated with the latest in technology and urban planning through online courses and forums.
